propositions: JiraDataCenterTransport lacks 12 methods the reconciler calls (delete_issue, delete_issue_link, get_comments, get_issue_by_rest, get_issue_links, get_parent_map, remove_label, set_entity_property, set_issue_property, set_parent, set_reporter, validate_assignee_exists), causing crashes in some call sites and silent degradation in others where exceptions are swallowed.

Most of the 12 missing methods have call sites that swallow all exceptions, so a DC deployment appears to converge while silently failing to sync comments, links, parents, properties, or validate assignees—a worse outcome than a crash because the green run masks the missing functionality.

TicketTransport protocol is missing @runtime_checkable decorator and declares only 6 members while the core actually requires 21 distinct transport methods, so isinstance conformance checks cannot work and the port does not describe its own requirement.

inbound_fields._identity_of reads only accountId, causing DC reporter fields (which have only name, not accountId) to perpetually differ and re-emit on every pass, violating the idempotence acceptance criterion even after set_reporter is implemented.

DC REST v2 pagination and field structures differ materially from Cloud v3 (e.g. get_parent_map uses offset startAt/maxResults not cursor tokens, epic membership is via Greenhopper API not fields.parent), so copying Cloud implementations produces 404/400 errors rather than working ports.

Each of the 12 absent members must carry a recorded verdict (IMPLEMENT with DC v2 payload, NotImplementedError naming the limitation, or documented as unreachable with upstream decision named) backed by call-site evidence, and all must be proven present via conformance guard at backend construction time.
